close_reason: Fixed in commit b39e3ca: CamelCase type names backtick-quoted across calendars-client method docs.
description:
clippy::pedantic doc_markdown finds many doc-comments referencing CamelCase type names without backticks. Rustdoc renders these as plain text, losing the link to the type's docs.

Examples (all from clippy --lib output):
- src/methods/event.rs:11 'CalendarEvent' (in Fetch CalendarEvent objects...)
- src/methods/event.rs:56 'CalendarEvent'
- src/methods/event.rs:81 'CalendarEvent'
- src/methods/event.rs:121 'CalendarEvent'
- src/methods/event.rs:158 'CalendarEvent'
- src/methods/event_copy.rs:8 'CalendarEvent'
- src/methods/event_copy.rs:12 'CalendarEvent'
- src/methods/event_notification.rs:10, :44, :73, :76, :115, :149 'CalendarEventNotification'
- src/methods/event_parse.rs:7 'CalendarEvent'
- src/methods/participant_identity.rs:6, :34, :59 'ParticipantIdentity'

Fix is mechanical: wrap CamelCase RFC type names in backticks: ```/// Fetch \`CalendarEvent\` objects by IDs```. Improves rustdoc rendering and aligns with the rest of the workspace style.
title: Type names in doc-comments are not backtick-quoted
